summary_1line: Vyasa explains omens and psychology of victory in war; Dhritarashtra later reflects on the coming battle and asks Sanjaya about the lands of the assembled kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: The blind king Dhritarashtra sits in silence, head bowed, sighing in his dark hall after Vyasa departs.
Warriors in glittering armor and standards stand beneath circling birds and bright skies while sacred fire burns smokeless beside them.
A vast army suddenly breaks in panic, soldiers scattering like a startled herd as banners fall and dust fills the air.
